description_sq:
Apartament 3+1 ne shitje te kodra e diellit, prane me njesine 13.
Pozicionohet te rruga Rrapo Hekali , pa arritur te Eleonora.
Apartament i bollshem me hapesira dhe me organizim perfekt,
Ka drite natyrale dhe ndodhet larg zhurmave te rrugeve.
description_en: 3+1 apartment for sale in the hill of the sun, near unit 13. It is located on Rrapo Hekali street, without reaching Eleonora. Spacious apartment with spaces and perfect organization, has natural light and is located away from the noise of the streets.
